identity: The Hub 01 Lower Extremity Gaitframe, or LEG, a powered exoskeleton for the true frontier cyborg.  A metal frame runs along each of the legs, with clasps for the hips, femurs, and knees, twisting at the lower leg into a metal plate with additional straps for the shin.  The frame covering the knee and lower leg has clips custom-fit for Hub 01 greaves, and there is a hip-mounted battery compartment.  When powered, you can move 15% faster, traverse obstacles with 50% higher efficiency, and carry 20kg of extra weight.  Unpowered, they are a significant burden.  Activate them to toggle power.  Requires an XM-LEG Interface bionic to function.
